rows.note: Use this all-purpose term for a person who has escaped custody or is fleeing from the law.

example.english: The police finally caught that runaway.
example.traditional: 警方終於捉到嗰個逃犯。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 zuk1 dou2 go2 go3 tou4 faan6

rows.note: Use this for an out-of-control train or, by extension, another vehicle in a similar situation.

example.english: That runaway train crashed into the platform.
example.traditional: 嗰架失控列車衝入咗月台。
example.jyutping: go2 gaa3 sat1 hung3 lit6 ce1 cung1 jap6 zo2 jyut6 toi4

rows.note: Use this when the runaway refers to an out-of-control or unstable process or condition.

example.english: The housing market has entered a runaway state.
example.traditional: 個樓市已經陷入失控狀態。
example.jyutping: go3 lau4 si5 ji5 ging1 ham6 jap6 sat1 hung3 zong6 taai3

rows.note: Use this for an overwhelming victory rather than merely an ordinary win.

example.english: We had a runaway victory over our opponents in this match.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 coeng4 bo1 daai6 sing3 deoi3 sau2
